verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks with a `webhook-id` idempotency header, opt-in webhook signing, and a `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED` webhook whose payload carries the screening result, so a system can react to outcomes without polling. Only the completion event is evidenced, not a full lifecycle (created, processing, requires-input). missing for 10: documented intermediate lifecycle event types (created/processing/requires-input), details of the signature verification scheme, a full event-type catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.
